name: Oversight Board Agenda August 21, 2018
agenda_text:
AGENDA FOR THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SECOND DISTRICT
  CONSOLIDATED OVERSIGHT BOARD, TO THE SUCCESSOR AGENCIES OF:

  Carson, Compton, Culver City, Hawthorne, Inglewood, Lawndale, Lynwood

  INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD, 9TH FLOOR
  INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA 90301
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 21, 2018

  6:00 P.M.

Board Members: Chair James T. Butts, Jr., Vice Chair Micah Ali, Board Member Keith Curry,
  Steve Koffroth, David Riccitiello, Mee Semcken, Pat Smith

AGENDA POSTED: Wednesday, August 15, 2018

WEBSITE: http://www.lacob.lacounty.gov

LOBBYIST REGISTRATION: Any person who seeks support or endorsement from the Oversight
Board on any official action may be subject to the provisions of Los Angeles County Code, Chapter
2.160 relating to lobbyists. Violation of the lobbyist ordinance may result in a fine and other penalty.
For further information, call (213) 974-1093.

ACCOMMODATIONS: Accommodations, American Sign Language (ASL) interpreters, or assisted
listening devices are available with at least three business days' notice before the meeting date.
Agendas in Braille and/or alternate formats are available upon request. Please telephone
(213) 974-1060 (voice) or (213) 974-1707 (TDD), from 8:00 a.m. 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.
Para Información en español, por favor comunίquese a la oficina de Servicios de Comisión al numero
(213) 974-1060 entre 8:00 a.m. Y 5:00 p.m. lunes a viernes.

SUPPORTING DOCUMENTATION: Supporting documentation can be obtained at the Commission
Services Office, Kenneth Hahn Hall of Administration, 500 West Temple Street, Room B 50,
Los Angeles, CA 90012.

  II. ROLL CALL

  III. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  V. CONSENT CALENDAR

  2.  None. (18-4749)

  VI. DISCUSSION

  Discussion regarding July 27, 2018 letter from Latham & Watkins alleging a violation
  3.  of the Ralph M. Brown Act by the former Oversight Board to the Successor Agency to
  the Inglewood Redevelopment Agency from an action taken on June 27, 2018; and
  letter from Chatten-Brown & Carstens LLP informing of a challenge to June 27, 2018
  approval to facilitate land transfer for Inglewood Clippers Arena Project, and take
  appropriate action as necessary:

   Oversight Board Discussion about the retention of independent legal counsel.
   Action directing the Chair and Vice-Chair to solicit, negotiate, and
  recommend to the Consolidated Oversight Board the hiring of legal counsel.
   Action directing staff to contact counsel for MSG Forum LLC to request an
  extension of time in which to respond to its July 27, 2018 letter until the
  Consolidated Oversight Board has successfully retained independent legal
  counsel by resolution. (18-4748)

  Attachments:  Latham & Watkins Correspondence
